name: tower
description: One place to see what a Claude session is costing, what its agents are doing, how far the build is, and whether Tank is healthy.

usageBand.title: Usage band
usageBand.description: Show usage windows, prompt-cache state and session cost above the prompt.

agentsPanel.title: Agents panel
agentsPanel.description: Track subagents: what they are doing, what they cost and how far along they are.

buildBar.title: Build status bar
buildBar.description: Show build progress with an estimated finish for local, CI and Tank builds.

tankPanel.title: Tank panel
tankPanel.description: Show activity, queue depth and health across your Tank instances.

tankServers.title: Tank instances
tankServers.description: The MCP server names of the Tank boxes to watch, one per entry, as /mcp lists them. Tower dials them with the engine's own connection, so it never needs their tokens.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: A token with Actions read access, so the build bar can follow CI runs for this repository. Stored in your operating system's keychain, never in a settings file. Leave empty to not watch CI at all.

notifyEnabled.title: Send WhatsApp notifications
notifyEnabled.description: The master switch. While this is off nothing is ever sent, whatever else is set. Messages go only to your own number, only from fixed templates.

whatsappServer.title: WhatsApp MCP server
whatsappServer.description: The name of your WhatsApp gateway as /mcp lists it. Tower dials it with the engine's own connection, so it never holds your gateway key.

notifyLevel.title: Notification level
notifyLevel.description: Milestones sends what needs you: failures, stopped agents, a spent rate limit, and anything on Tank waiting for an answer. Verbose adds successes and warnings. Silent sends nothing.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Local time range during which messages are held and delivered as one morning digest. Empty disables quiet hours.

tankWatchdog.title: Tank watchdog
tankWatchdog.description: alert surfaces stalled or failed jobs and waits for you. resume also retries transient failures automatically, capped and logged.
